tasks.title: Community garden project
tasks.instruction: You must answer this question. Write your answer in about 100 words.

promptBlocks.subject: Community garden project
paragraphs: Our class is helping to plan a community garden beside the railway. We need to decide on the main goal. Should we focus on growing food for local families or on creating a green space for everyone to enjoy? Which do you think is more important and why?
Also, we need to choose one practical feature for the garden. Would you prefer a seating area with benches or a small tool shed?
Finally, can you suggest one way to encourage people to help look after the garden long-term?

promptBlocks.heading: Notes for your reply
listItems: Say which main goal you prefer and explain why.
Choose a feature (seating area or tool shed) and give a reason.
Suggest one way to get long-term help.
Ask Ms. Rivera about the garden location.

promptBlocks.text: Write your email to Ms. Rivera using all the notes.

tasks.title: Community garden article
tasks.instruction: Answer one of these questions. Write your answer in about 100 words.

promptBlocks.heading: Articles wanted!
paragraphs: A new community garden is being planned beside the railway in our neighbourhood.
What do you think is the most important thing about a community garden?
How can it help people who live nearby?
Write an article answering these questions and we will put it on our local website!

tasks.title: Story about the garden
tasks.instruction: Answer one of these questions. Write your answer in about 100 words.

promptBlocks.text: Your English teacher has asked you to write a story.
Your story must begin with this sentence:
"When I arrived at the community garden, I saw that someone had planted flowers in the shape of a star."
